scope: Retain complete deferred bridge objects in a fixed registry and opportunistically reclaim only fences reporting VK_SUCCESS
registry_ownership: ACTIVE -> REAPING -> FREE, or ACTIVE -> REAPING -> QUARANTINED -> REAPING -> FREE; slots remain charged through native teardown; allocation reservations also charge existing atomic quota
caller_contract: Existing single GL-owner thread and resource-reference ownership must serialize ACTIVE refresh/destruction. Destroy relinquishes the pointer once; callers never retry a deferred pointer. Only registry-owned QUARANTINED entries are polled.
call_serialization_evidence: external/crosvm/rutabaga_gfx/src/rutabaga_core.rs: RutabagaResource documents a single-threaded library; Rutabaga holds non-Send/non-Sync dyn component/context trait objects
external/crosvm/rutabaga_gfx/src/virgl_renderer.rs: init pins global thread-bound GL contexts; unref_resource contract says no user can still hold a reference
external/virglrenderer/src/vrend_renderer.c: gb_android_resource_read is reached by the resource owner; destroy releases EGL image then transfers gb_android_image before freeing vrend resource
concurrency_scope: Mutex protects registry transitions; atomic try-gate serializes nonwaiting reaper passes. This does not make the rest of virglrenderer or ACTIVE image API thread-safe.
limitations: Permanently failing/missing fence status retains resources and consumes quota until process exit
No guarantee of a Vulkan driver API wall-clock deadline; reaper makes no WaitForFences/QueueWaitIdle/DeviceWaitIdle calls
No new EGL/GL calls in reaper; existing GL read completion and caller ownership contract remain required
reaper_triggers: valid-layout image admission before slot reservation
image destruction after claiming ACTIVE ownership

scenarios: sixteen partial creation failures roll back all reservations and FDs
completion after original resource owner disappears
sixteen contending reaper threads claim each of eight objects once
device-lost status retains complete eight-object backing and refuses ninth
missing status function retains complete eight-object backing and refuses ninth
host_validation.scope: Actual patched bridge C with mock Vulkan/AHB functions and real owned Linux descriptors; no GPU driver, Android compile, EGL lifetime or device/runtime qualification
